task.title: P6-163: Stop move picker from showing loading and empty states simultaneously
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Accessibility). Original id: P6-163. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-components.md.

**The move picker renders "Loading collections…" and "No collection to move into." simultaneously** (was `P6-024g`; `tree_manage.rs:648-654`) — the `Transition` shows the first while `CommandEmpty` shows the second because zero items are registered. The same latent pattern exists in the other `DestinationList` consumer. A visible instance of `P6-011`; fix here or fix at the primitive.
